enrich_summary.reasoning_short: The marker list is dominated by proximal tubule-specific genes: AKR1C1, HOGA1, SLC16A12, PAX8, CHDH, TINAG, ALDOB, GPD1, PDZK1IP1, PAH, GSTA1, GLYAT, BHMT, BHMT2, SLC13A1, S100A1, UGT2B7, PTGR1, NAT8, CA2, KCNJ16, and AP1M2. These are classic markers of renal proximal tubules, with HOGA1, SLC13A1, and SLC16A12 especially specific to the S3 segment. While PAX8 is a general kidney epithelial marker, the co-expression of SLC13A1 (sulfate transporter), SLC16A12 (monocarboxylate transporter), and BHMT/BHMT2 (betaine metabolism) strongly localizes to proximal tubule S3. The enriched pathways include multiple metabolism terms (KEGG: hsa00920, hsa00130, hsa00604, etc.), consistent with the high metabolic activity of PTECs. No markers for endothelial, immune, or distal nephron segments are present, and the absence of podocyte markers (NPHS1, NPHS2) and loop of Henle markers (SLC12A1) confirms this assignment.
